description: This Java source file defines the class 'NonsenseGenerator', which generates random news headlines and articles by constructing sentences with randomly selected words and phrases. It serves as a utility for creating placeholder or mock data for testing or fun purposes.

classes.name: NonsenseGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates random news headlines and articles by assembling sentences from predefined word lists and phrases.

methods.name: makeSentence
methods.description: Creates a sentence, formatted as a headline or regular sentence based on the parameter.

methods.name: makeText
methods.description: Produces a block of text consisting of a specified number of sentences.

methods.name: generateSentence
methods.description: Constructs a sentence by adding words and phrases, possibly including time clauses if not a headline.

methods.name: generateTimeClause
methods.description: Adds a time-related phrase to the sentence words list.

methods.name: generateAgent
methods.description: Adds an agent (noun phrase) to the sentence.

methods.name: generatePredicate
methods.description: Adds a predicate (verb phrase) and subsequent complements to the sentence.

methods.name: pickOneOf
methods.description: Selects one option at random from provided options.

methods.name: joinWords
methods.description: Joins list of words into a sentence string with proper spacing and punctuation.
